targetYaml:
version: 1
kind: target
name: core
core:
    amf: ${LAB_AMF}
    plmn:
        mcc: 208
        mnc: 93
    slices:
        - sst: 1
          sd: 010203
runYaml:
# The conformance suite against the target's core, every group, gated
# under the default policy: no FAIL, CRASH, BLOCKED, ERROR, DEVIATION or
# WARN outside the expected-failures list.
kind: run
workloads:
  - name: conformance
    conformance: {groups: [], per_test_timeout_ms: 3000}
gates:
  - name: conformance
    conformance: true
